verdict.rationale: Bento's FAQ says you see "cost per run" out of the box, and the CLI docs confirm a dashboard with analytics. That covers per-request cost visibility, but only through a single thin mention. Missing for 10: token usage metrics, cost/token breakdown by model, time-period aggregation or filtering of spend in dashboards, detailed first-party docs on cost dashboards, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
